keywords.text: 電池 (battery) mentioned — remove batteries before posting; lithium batteries are restricted in air mail.
ジャンク (junk / sold as-is) — may be faulty. Test before you list.
並行輸入 / 海外版 (parallel import / overseas version) — not Japan-only, so little price edge abroad.
中古 (used) item — 古物商許可 (secondhand dealer licence) required to buy for resale.
Alcohol — selling needs a 酒類販売業免許 (liquor sales licence) and many carriers restrict it.
Food — import rules vary widely by country. Avoid.
Cosmetics — ingredient and import rules vary. Avoid.
Swords / replica swords — export and import heavily restricted.
Japanese 100V adapter included — mention voltage in your listing.
限定 (limited edition) — check eBay sold prices; limited runs can sell well above normal.

US.text: US: no duty-free threshold. Since 15 Oct 2026 every post office accepts US parcels, but goods you sold need a pre-declaration in Japan Post's partner app (Zonos) with duty prepaid and a DDP label.
US duty estimate: 12.5% total on most Japanese goods (Section 301, since 24 Jul 2026). Rate is set in config.yaml.

EU.text: EU: eBay collects VAT at checkout on orders up to €150. Since 1 Jul 2026 a €3 customs duty also applies; with your own Japan Post shipping the carrier may collect it (plus a handling fee) from the buyer.

GB.text: UK: eBay collects VAT on orders up to £135. Above that the buyer pays VAT and a carrier fee on delivery.

CA.text: Canada: eBay doesn't collect import tax for parcels from Japan. The buyer pays GST/HST (and any duty) plus a Canada Post handling fee on delivery — a common cause of refused parcels. Say so in the listing.

AU.text: Australia: eBay adds GST at checkout (orders up to A$1,000) — write eBay's ABN and code PAID on the customs form. Declare any wooden parts (knife handles, saya); Australia inspects wood.

NZ.text: New Zealand: eBay adds GST at checkout (orders up to NZ$1,000) — write eBay's IRD number and code PAID on the customs form. Declare any wooden parts.

BR.text: Brazil: very high import taxes paid by the buyer on delivery, and slow customs. Many Japan sellers exclude Brazil.

MX.text: Mexico: buyer pays import tax on delivery and parcels can be slow through customs.

ZA.text: South Africa: buyer pays VAT and duty on delivery; parcels can be slow through customs.
